# Package manifest

Name: Desktop Canvas UI Design Skill
Version: 1.0.0
Purpose: AI-agent instructions for professional desktop-first, canvas-based creative/productivity software.

## Contents

- `SKILL.md` — core instructions and rules.
- `AI-PROMPTS.md` — task prompts for build, audit, theming, canvas interaction, and QA.
- `COPILOT-INSTRUCTIONS-SNIPPET.md` — text to merge into Copilot repository instructions.
- `README.md` — installation and usage.
- `references/01-design-tokens.md` — sizes, palettes, typography, spacing, themes and icons.
- `references/02-desktop-shell-and-layouts.md` — app shell, panels, toolbars and responsive desktop rules.
- `references/03-canvas-editor-ux.md` — canvas model, transforms, selection, snapping, zoom, persistence and performance.
- `references/04-components-and-interactions.md` — buttons, fields, tooltip copy, menus, dialogs, shortcuts and input contracts.
- `references/05-accessibility-and-responsiveness.md` — WCAG-aligned keyboard, focus, contrast, target size, text scaling and alternate interactions.
- `references/06-react-typescript-architecture.md` — React/Vite/Next.js/Zustand and document/rendering architecture.
- `references/07-code-recipes.md` — TypeScript, React, Zustand, CSS and command patterns.
- `references/08-quality-gates.md` — review rubric, definition of done, test matrix and anti-patterns.
- `references/09-reference-sources.md` — official technical documentation links.
- `references/10-product-archetypes.md` — label/print, image, word processing, presentation and diagram patterns.

## Recommended placement in a repository

Copy this folder to `docs/skills/desktop-canvas-ui-design/`, then merge the text in `COPILOT-INSTRUCTIONS-SNIPPET.md` into `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. If another agent only accepts one file, attach the standalone `DESKTOP-CANVAS-UI-DESIGN-SKILL.md`.
